title: 2001 HMMT February General Round 1 Problem 1
statement: What is the last digit of \(17^{103}+5\) ?

solutions.text: Let \(\langle N\rangle\) be the last digit of \(N .\left\langle 17^{2}\right\rangle=9,\left\langle 17^{3}\right\rangle=3,\left\langle 17^{4}\right\rangle=1\), and \(\left\langle 17^{5}\right\rangle=7\). Since this pattern keeps on repeating itself, \(\left\langle 17^{4 N}\right\rangle=1\) for any integer \(N\). Thus \(\left\langle 17^{2 \cdot 25}\right\rangle=\) \(\left\langle 17^{100}\right\rangle=1\), so \(\left\langle 17^{103}\right\rangle=3\), and \(\left\langle 17^{103}+5\right\rangle=\langle 3+5\rangle=8\).
